_comment: LEGACY-RESEARCH-ONLY rate/limit fixture retained for offline compatibility tests. It is not a current offer source and must never drive checkout, invoicing, metering, ARR, or pipeline. Current commercial offers live in site/pricing.json.
_plan_visibility: Free, Developer, Pro, Scale, Compute, Team, and Production Pilot are retired. Public checkout and usage billing remain disabled during Plonky3 backend recovery.

billing_meters._comment: Declares which Stripe meter each plan bills through. sync_usage.py and parity tests enforce this mapping. 'compute' tenants are metered by raw trace steps via trace_step_usage ($0.50/1M steps); all other plans use proof_usage (discounted cents-per-proof). The monthly_cap_cents on the compute plan is a coarse safety bound only — real billing is the step meter.

compute._comment: Billed via trace_step_usage meter ($0.50/1M steps), NOT the cents-per-proof tiers. monthly_cap_cents is a coarse safety bound only.

plan_aliases._comment: Legacy plan slugs from prior pricing iterations. 'standard' was an early developer-tier label. 'team' was the sales-only/intermediate plan and now resolves to the public Pro tier.
